name: @inid/expo
description: Sign-in with InID for React Native and Expo: <InIDProvider>, useInID(), <SignInButton> and friends. A public client with PKCE, the system's secure browser and tokens in the Keychain/Keystore.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && ../../node_modules/.bin/esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --target=es2020 --external:react --external:react-native --external:expo-auth-session --external:expo-web-browser --external:expo-secure-store --external:expo-crypto --outfile=dist/index.js && ../../node_modules/.bin/tsc src/index.ts --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 --skipLibCheck
